title: A test: Mining-skill work for Solarian-born miners: ore of Markab Alloy Seam into storage at Procyon Colonial Station (one jump)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 00:39 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6 and O1, O2; rules F22, F23, F37).
